ITEM 1 | Pale cream-to-white grains, separate and fluffy with some moisture, mixed with tan-brown flecks and small golden bits; occupies the center-lower left of the plate, roughly 9 cm across and 2 cm tall, sitting partly under and beside the chunks of meat and greens | 150
ITEM 2 | Irregular bite-size pieces of pale off-white flesh with golden-brown browned edges and crisp-looking surface spots, moist and slightly flaky, about 3 to 4 cm across and 1.5 cm thick, clustered at the lower center of the plate over the grains | 130
ITEM 3 | Dark green wilted leaves with glossy, slightly limp texture and visible pale stems and veins, some leaf edges curled, spread over the upper right of the plate covering about one quarter of its surface, around 2 cm tall in a loose mound | 90
ITEM 4 | Small scattered dark green leaf pieces, flat and slightly glossy, mixed among the grains and meat on the left side of the plate, about 1 cm each | 10
ITEM 5 | Small cream-colored pieces of meat-like chunks mixed into the grains with light browning, moist and tender, scattered in the center-left near the grains, about 1 to 2 cm each | 30
